Context: 10. Authorization of Pension and Gratuity

4. Revision of pension after final authorization.Except in cases covered by Rules 7 and 8 of CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021, pension once authorized after final assessment should not be revised to the disadvantage of the Government servant, unless such revision becomes necessary on account of detection of a clerical error subsequently.
